coordinate_frame: same MODEL meter; same committed source time
mapping: source T1/B1 lower airfoil arc after MODEL flip corresponds to template blade0 upper arc; capture/evaluation only
source_side_indices: source ring48 j=24..47 plus seam j0 for wrap47->0; root/tip excluded by xi bands
template_side_indices: template ring32 j=0..16, upper arc; lateral triangles only
region_rule: exact linear clipping of each triangle by immutable reference material xi. Current MODEL z is not span. Global region is union of three bands.
metric: bidirectional point-to-triangle surface distance; same correct side/region target meshes, no ICP/pose/scale alignment

sampler.area_weighting: each direction uniformly sampled by its own current mesh triangle area, internally normalized; directions weight .5/.5; same source samples per frame across all groups

aggregate.per_frame_mean: equal direction means; area weights inside each region/global union
aggregate.p95: quantile of equally mixed direction/time/clip distributions; not average of directional P95

q_eval.source: same first WideInput RGB pixels on each frozen estimated blade0; nearest lateral ray hit; upper side enforced
q_eval.miss_rule: null explicit failure counts; no success-only denominators

invalid_rule: zero area/nonfinite/frame missing => failed/null, not0 or omitted; retain planned denominators
secondary_source_reference: known synthetic marker vertices only independent evaluation, not source-rays to initialize solver; directsource and historicalray refs separate
noise_band: delta_dev=max(P95 paired perturb gain difference, numericalmethod gain difference, density gain difference). delta_min=max(.005,2delta_dev), protection max(.25,dev projectionband). Bands are development sensitivity, not CI.
